Simplified vs VEXI: Campaigns or Your Whole Social Media?
Simplified and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Simplified gives you an AI agent, Riley, that turns your brief into a campaign for you to approve [1]. Here is how it compares with one app built around your own footage and your own business.

Simplified sells AI agents for marketing [1]. You brief its AI agent, Riley, in plain language, and it makes the designs, video, captions and email, then schedules them once you approve; nothing ships until you do [1][2]. Every plan also includes Simplified's design, video, writing and social scheduling tools on their own [2]. Its pricing page shows Pro from $19 a month, billed annually [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Simplified's brief, review and ship model is close to how VEXI works [1]. VEXI also edits your own clips with B-roll, music and captions, makes long-form video, and Autopilot keeps the week going. VEXI plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Simplified's AI agent starts from your brief, and reads your Brand Kit, your website and your top posts before it makes anything [1].
Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Simplified's AI agent can run a weekly workflow that drafts next week's posts from what worked last week and queues them for one approval [1].
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
Designs posts and carousels in your brand
An AI agent for marketing that plans, makes and schedules campaigns for you to approve, at a lower price [1][2].
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.

You brief its AI agent, Riley, in plain language [1]. It makes the designs, video, captions and email, and nothing ships until you approve it [1][2]. Every plan also includes Simplified's design, video, writing and social scheduling tools on their own [2].
Can Simplified edit my own videos?

Simplified has an AI video editor that works in the browser, and its AI agent can cut a webinar or podcast into captioned clips and draft a post for each one [1]. VEXI edits your own footage too: cuts, B-roll, music and captions.
Simplified's pricing page shows Pro from $19 a month, billed annually [2]. Its pricing page also offers a 7-day trial of Pro or Business [2].
